step1.title: Access Pennylane and ensure your compliance with the electronic invoicing reform
step1.subtitlePart1: We are updating your invoicing and accounting environment to

reform.title: Electronic invoice reform
reform.description1: The electronic invoicing reform will progressively generalize electronic exchanges of invoices from 2026. This reform impacts our organization, which is why we have chosen to anticipate it now to guarantee your compliance and ensure the continuation of our missions.
reform.description2Part1: To receive and issue compliant invoices
reform.description2Part2: additional work to update customer and supplier files is necessary by our teams (supplier files only for companies carrying out VAT-exempt sales operations).

pennylane.title: Pennylane
pennylane.descriptionPart1: To make this reform an opportunity to optimize your management experience and improve collaboration,
pennylane.descriptionBold: RYDGE Conseil has chosen to use the Approved Pennylane Platform,
pennylane.descriptionPart2: in order to centralize your finances, automate your accounting management tasks and save precious time on a daily basis.

step2.title: 1/3 Your support towards the reform
step2.reformDescription: The Electronic Invoicing reform requires a mandatory upgrade for every company. This step includes the compliance of your invoicing as well as the activation of the Pennylane platform. The subscription amount varies according to your company's needs.

pennylane.title: Why Pennylane?

pennylane.item3: your Approved Platform, integrated with your financial management solution, allows you to centralize your operations and ensure optimal fluidity between your accounting and management processes.
